description: This file defines the interface for the Digital Input/Output (DIO) module adhering to the AUTOSAR standards. It declares functions for initializing DIO, reading/writing channels and ports, flipping channels, reading channel groups, and retrieving version information.

methods.name: Dio_Init
methods.description: Initializes the DIO module with the provided configuration.

methods.name: Dio_ReadChannel
methods.description: Reads the current level of the specified DIO channel.

methods.name: Dio_WriteChannel
methods.description: Sets the level of the specified DIO channel.

methods.name: Dio_FlipChannel
methods.description: Toggles the level of the specified DIO channel.

methods.name: Dio_ReadPort
methods.description: Reads the level of all pins in the specified port.

methods.name: Dio_WritePort
methods.description: Writes a level to all pins in the specified port.

methods.name: Dio_MaskedWritePort
methods.description: Performs a masked write operation on the port.

methods.name: Dio_ReadChannelGroup
methods.description: Reads a group of channels defined by a ChannelGroupType.

methods.name: Dio_WriteChannelGroup
methods.description: Writes a level to a group of channels.

methods.name: Dio_GetVersionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves the version information of the DIO module.
